verdicts.reason: Both have the same breakage. The cream circle that sat behind the can has come loose and is cut off in the bottom-left corner. Without it the orange can disappears into the orange background, leaving only a 'SOLSTICE' band and two green dots. The headline is small and left-aligned while the can and buttons are centred, and the NEW pill and Try It button float in empty space. A is worse because the faint can sits at the top and the headline at mid-height, so it reads product first, then message. B at least follows brand/headline → product → NEW → CTA, with a slightly larger product. B still has a big empty gap between the subcopy and the can.
